markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (57%)** · Ambiguous: Invasive vs Benign · Careful review
Simulated frozen section shows positive superior/lateral margins [F7], blocked stain orders, and unexcluded Benign tissue.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 57%, Benign 33%, InSitu 8%, Normal 2% (ECE 5%) [F1] | Split between Invasive and Benign |
| Conformal set | Benign, Invasive (alpha 10%; 90% coverage, n=132) | Cannot separate Invasive from Benign |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 90th OOD percentile, 12/12 regions kept [F6] | Passes QC; error AUROC 70% |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent backbones agree with each other |
| Similar cases | 20% match (1/5 Invasive; 4/5 InSitu, closest 88% InSitu) [F5] | Neighbors favor InSitu over Invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 1, 3) · ↑ invasive · Strongest positive score (+1.31); 19/20 AI spot check [F2] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 0, 1, 2) · ↑ invasive · Unreliable score (+0.42); failed AI spot check (0/20) [F3] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 6, 9, 10) · ↓ invasive · Pulls away from invasive (-0.35); text-only, 18/20 spot check [F4] · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 10) · context · Descriptive score (+0.32); differs from closest InSitu neighbor (8/20) · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions drops P(invasive) more than random (CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); leans on unreliable mitoses (0/20 AI spot check).

## Could be wrong if
- High-risk regions (0–3) represent InSitu rather than invasion, matching 4/5 similar reference cases.
- Composite benign glands (regions 6, 9, 10) or frozen-section artifacts drive the split Invasive (57%) versus Benign (33%) call.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 2, 3**: Verify stromal invasion versus InSitu along the positive superior margin (538 um); check mitoses directly.
2. **Regions 3, 7**: Inspect the positive lateral margin (215 um involved) to confirm whether tumor reaches the edge.
3. **Regions 6, 9, 10**: Review low-risk glandular areas (0%–6% risk) to confirm benign tubules and fibrous stroma.
